findings: A new bounded tensor-audit publisher requires the active matching quality recorder, exact slot request, completed bounded training receipts, evaluation contract/token lineage, distinct canonical raw/H200 files and a bound projection copy. The inherited7200s/4GiB RSS/6GiB MPS driver/8GiB reserve interval continues through tensor checking; no new time or memory allowance is granted.

The publisher invokes the existing read-only metadata/meta-device and mmap CPU tensor checker. It records immutable attempt/producer input hashes, rechecks STOP, checkpoints and protected metadata, and writes a bounded tensor-audit.json. Exceptions retain failure/partial artifacts; attempts never retry. Large file hashing stays outside the metadata namespace lock so the resource observer can publish.

The quality body now performs this audit before resource success and binds its SHA in the worker completion. The v2 LR/rank stage wrapper verifies tensor producer provenance; missing evidence, incorrect plan/contract, changed inputs, overstated numerical claims, failure markers and partial audits prevent acceptance.

Tiny real mmap tensor fixtures verify finiteness, exact exported EMA values and persistent buffers. Synthetic negative fixtures catch NaN, wrong EMA, changed buffers, input/attempt mutation, STOP, invalid resource intervals and oversized reports. Publication never deletes or rewrites checkpoint inputs.

The initial suite rejected missing training-output evidence with a generic KeyError rather than the explicit ValueError contract. An explicit required-input check fixes the validation interface; the failed log is retained. The final481-test suite includes quality producer/stage tests and pilot dispatch/boundary/resource/writer regressions.
limitations: Actual wide-model metadata checks and MPS observations are mocked in tensor-publisher fixtures. Small tensor value/mmap operations, bounded publication, guards and provenance rejection run for real. Composition fixtures mock scientific training/evaluation/tensor phases. These tests do not establish real numerical continuation, optimizer correctness, EMA recurrence, cache behavior or model quality.
No research training or MPS pilot launched, no research checkpoint was deleted, no closed campaign or failed combined CPU numerical fixture was rerun, and the test holdout remains closed.

Quality startup/selection-aware dispatch, complete LR/rank cleanup and inference orchestration remain unintegrated. The nine numerical/input and measured-pilot prerequisites remain unresolved. The full27-trajectory plan remains unfrozen and current full storage must be checked before any real transition.
